Body.Content:
Keep critical business data consistent across environments with cross-environment master data management. Centrally manage and govern master data—including customers, vendors, products, and reference data—and keep it synchronized wherever it is used, reducing duplicate maintenance and simplifying administration.

Benefits

• Maintain a single source of truth for master data across development, test, and production environments.

• Reduce manual effort and inconsistent records by synchronizing master data across environments.

• Improve data accuracy and reliability with standardized data definitions and governance policies, while supporting faster environment setup and smoother application lifecycle management.

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
